metas.name: The Big Short
metas.description: Prior to the 2008 financial crisis, a group of investors bet against the US mortgage market and are stunned by the corruption they uncover through their research.

metas.name: The Cabin in the Woods

metas.name: Kill Bill: Vol. 1
metas.description: After waking from a four-year coma, a former assassin wreaks vengeance on the team of assassins who betrayed her.

metas.name: Grave of the Fireflies

metas.name: The Martian
metas.description: An astronaut stranded on Mars must rely on his ingenuity to survive and arrange a potential rescue.

metas.name: Cars

metas.name: Hook

metas.name: A League of Their Own
metas.description: During World War II, sisters Dottie and Kit join the first female professional baseball league and struggle to help it succeed amid their own growing rivalry.

metas.name: Blade Runner

metas.name: Ready Player One
metas.description: When the creator of a virtual reality called the OASIS dies, he makes a posthumous challenge to all OASIS users to find his Easter Egg, which will give the finder his fortune and control of his world.

metas.name: Heretic

metas.name: Anyone But You
metas.description: After an amazing first date, Bea and Ben's fiery attraction turns ice-cold--until they find themselves unexpectedly reunited at a wedding in Australia. So they do what any two mature adults would do: pretend to be a couple.

metas.name: 2001: A Space Odyssey
metas.description: When a mysterious artifact is uncovered on the Moon, a spacecraft manned by two scientists and one supercomputer is dispatched to Jupiter to find its origins.

metas.name: White Chicks

metas.name: Wind River

metas.name: X2: X-Men United

metas.name: What Women Want

metas.name: Hoppers

metas.name: Sing 2

metas.name: A Beautiful Mind

metas.name: The Hills Have Eyes

metas.name: Soylent Green

metas.name: House of 1000 Corpses
metas.description: Two young couples traveling across the backwoods of Texas searching for urban legends of murder end up as prisoners of a bizarre and sadistic backwater family of serial killers.

metas.name: Don't Worry Darling

metas.name: The Night House
metas.description: A widow begins to uncover her recently deceased husband's disturbing secrets.

metas.name: Babylon
metas.description: A tale of outsized ambition and outrageous excess, it traces the rise and fall of multiple characters during an era of unbridled decadence and depravity in early Hollywood.

metas.name: Logan

metas.name: The Grinch
metas.description: A grumpy Grinch plots to ruin Christmas for the village of Whoville.

metas.name: The Lion King
metas.description: Lion prince Simba and his father are targeted by his bitter uncle, who wants to ascend the throne himself.

metas.name: Forgetting Sarah Marshall

metas.name: 28 Days Later
metas.description: Four weeks after a mysterious, incurable virus spreads throughout the United Kingdom, a handful of survivors try to find sanctuary.

metas.name: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre
metas.description: After picking up a traumatized young hitchhiker, five friends find themselves stalked and hunted by a deformed chainsaw-wielding loon and his family of equally psychopathic killers.

metas.name: Aliens

metas.name: The Life of Chuck
metas.description: A life-affirming, genre-bending story about three chapters in the life of an ordinary man named Charles Krantz.

metas.name: Nightcrawler
metas.description: A petty thief desperate for work muscles into the world of crime journalism and becomes the star of his own story as he blurs the line between observer and participant.

metas.name: Don't Look Up

metas.name: Dogma

metas.name: Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy

metas.name: My Cousin Vinny
metas.description: Two New Yorkers accused of murder in rural Alabama while on their way back to college call in the help of one of their cousins, a loudmouth lawyer with no trial experience.

metas.name: Pan's Labyrinth
metas.description: In 1944 Francoist Spain, an imaginative young girl meets a faun who tells her she's a princess and that she must prove her worthiness by completing three dangerous tasks.

metas.name: The Hobbit: An Unexpected Journey
metas.description: A reluctant Hobbit, Bilbo Baggins, sets out to the Lonely Mountain with a spirited group of dwarves to reclaim their mountain home and the gold within it from the dragon Smaug.

metas.name: Terminator Salvation
metas.description: As the machines prepare for a final attack, John Connor and a mysterious stranger delve into the heart of Skynet and uncover a terrible secret involving the annihilation of mankind.

metas.name: Drive
metas.description: A mysterious Hollywood action film stuntman gets in trouble with gangsters when he tries to help his neighbor's husband rob a pawn shop while serving as his getaway driver.

metas.name: Little Women
metas.description: In 19th century Massachusetts, the March sisters--Meg, Jo, Beth, and Amy--on the threshold of womanhood, go through many ups and downs in life and endeavor to make important decisions about their futures.

metas.name: 12 Monkeys
metas.description: In a future world devastated by disease, a convict is sent back in time to gather information about the man-made virus that wiped out most of the human population on the planet.

metas.name: My Fault: London
metas.description: An 18-year-old girl moves from America to London with her mother and wealthy stepfather. When she meets her stepbrother, an attraction sparks despite their efforts. Her estranged father also tracks her down after his release from ...

metas.name: The Hateful Eight
metas.description: In the dead of a Wyoming winter with a blizzard on the way, a bounty hunter and his prisoner find shelter in a remote stagecoach way station inhabited by a collection of nefarious characters.

metas.name: Ballerina

metas.name: Roofman

metas.name: The Game

metas.name: Mother!

metas.name: Saltburn

metas.description: Based on the true life experiences of poet Jimmy Santiago Baca, the film focuses on step-brothers Paco and Cruz, and their bi-racial cousin Miklo.

metas.name: The Hobbit: The Desolation of Smaug
metas.description: The dwarves, along with Bilbo Baggins and Gandalf the Grey, continue their quest to reclaim the Lonely Mountain, their homeland, from the dragon Smaug.

metas.name: Les Misérables

metas.name: Longlegs

metas.name: The Exorcist

metas.name: Coherence
metas.description: Strange things begin to happen when a group of friends gather for a dinner party on an evening when a comet is passing overhead.

metas.name: Dawn of the Dead

metas.name: Toy Story

metas.name: A Quiet Place

metas.name: Star Wars: Episode V - The Empire Strikes Back

metas.name: Your Name.

metas.name: Primal Fear

metas.name: Edge of Tomorrow
metas.description: A man fighting in a war against aliens must relive the same day every time he dies until he can find a way to stop their power source with the help of an elite soldier.

metas.name: Legend

metas.name: A Few Good Men

metas.name: Barbie

metas.name: Avatar

metas.name: Karate Kid: Legends

metas.name: The Wild Robot

metas.name: Sing

metas.name: Fantastic Mr. Fox

metas.name: The Shadow's Edge

metas.name: It: Chapter Two

metas.name: Eternals

metas.name: Regretting You

metas.name: Collateral

metas.name: A Bronx Tale

metas.name: Steel Magnolias

metas.name: Jack Reacher: Never Go Back

metas.name: The Pelican Brief

metas.name: Materialists
metas.description: An ambitious young New York City matchmaker finds herself torn between the perfect match and her imperfect ex.

metas.name: Peaky Blinders: The Immortal Man
metas.description: During World War II, Tommy Shelby returns to a bombed Birmingham and becomes involved in secret wartime missions facing new threats as he reckons with his past.
